why_it_moved.text: Successful Search Rate is flat at +0.02% and the daily series is flat too, so v7 ranks differently but does not change how often searches succeed.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: Time to First Click on tail queries is the one clear mover, and it got slower; one mover among this many metrics is what luck alone gives, so treat it as a lead.
why_it_moved.label: inferred

why_it_moved.text: No coverage metric (share of queries whose top results changed) is on the scorecard, so we can't say whether v7 changed enough results to matter.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: A pre-exposure comparison of Successful Search Rate showing a gap between arms before exposure would void this result.
A tail-query cut showing Successful Search Rate or Abandonment Rate worse there would make the tail slowdown a real harm for triage.
